name: rules-rtdb-r46-deploy-regex-constructs
description: RTDB rules deploy verdicts for corpus scenario "r46-deploy-regex-constructs" (rtdb#71). Captured by dry-run deploys to the rules endpoint, which validate without deploying. regex constructs outside the documented set (lookahead, backreference, \b, lazy quantifiers, \p{..}, mid-pattern anchors) load in pyric and are evaluated with JavaScript RegExp semantics; production may refuse them at deploy.

SP-2: Unicode property class \\p{L}.error: Illegal regular expression, integer expected at position 3

SP-1: ^ and $ inside an alternation (/^r.error: Illegal regular expression, unescaped ^, ^ can only appear at the end of regular expressions

SP-1: ^ inside a group (/(^a)/).error: Illegal regular expression, unescaped ^, ^ can only appear at the end of regular expressions
